The season began on 2016 and was scheduled to end in May 2017. Ten teams competed throughout the entire season. ==Teams== [[Atlético Chiriquí]] finished in 10th place in the overall table last season and were relegated to the [[Liga Nacional de Ascenso]]. Taking their place for this season are the overall champions of last season's Liga Nacional de Ascenso [[Santa Gema F.C.|Santa Gema]].
